text.en: ESMFold is row 110 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the AI4Science area.
text.zh: ESMFold 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 110 行，所属领域为“AI for Science”。

text.en: The annual table associates ESMFold with “Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model”.
text.zh: 年度表把 ESMFold 与论文《Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Zeming Lin, Halil Akin, Roshan Rao, Brian Hie, Alexander Rives”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 林泽明、哈利勒·阿金、罗尚·拉奥、布赖恩·希、亚历山大·里夫斯；官方英文原文为“Zeming Lin, Halil Akin, Roshan Rao, Brian Hie, Alexander Rives”。

text.en: ESMFold predicts protein structure from a single sequence without requiring a multiple-sequence-alignment search.
text.zh: ESMFold 从单条序列预测蛋白质结构，不需要执行多序列比对搜索。

text.en: The model’s speed enabled structure prediction across hundreds of millions of metagenomic protein sequences.
text.zh: 模型的速度使对数亿条宏基因组蛋白质序列进行结构预测成为可能。
